title: pkix-profiles: an SMTP MTA profile, because BasicTlsProfile silently breaks SMTP DANE
description:
## The trap

verify_smtp_server_dane takes a Profile for DANE-TA(2) path validation. The obvious choice, BasicTlsProfile, sets require_subject_alt_name. That is correct for the Web PKI and wrong for MTA-to-MTA SMTP.

RFC 7672 section 3.2.3 consults the commonName when a certificate presents no DNS-ID, precisely because MTA certificates frequently carry their name only there. A SAN-requiring profile rejects those certificates during PATH VALIDATION, before any name check runs.

The symptom is unhelpfully indirect: Failed(PathValidationFailed(Path(MissingSan))) on a server whose certificate RFC 7672 accepts without reservation. Someone debugging that has no obvious reason to suspect the profile.

## Why this is worth a crate change rather than only documentation

It is documented on verify_smtp_server_dane now, which helps whoever reads the rustdoc. But the failure mode is that a caller reaches for the obvious profile and gets a silent incompatibility with the deployments the feature exists to serve. A shipped profile makes the right choice the easy one.

## What it should assert

Needs deciding rather than guessing:

- require_subject_alt_name: FALSE. This is the whole point.
- EKU: RFC 7672 does not require id-kp-serverAuth. Many MTA certificates carry it, some do not. Requiring it would reject working RFC 7672 deployments, so probably not required -- but worth confirming against what MTAs actually publish.
- Validity dates: DANE-EE(3) skips path validation entirely so dates do not arise. DANE-TA(2) validates a path, so dates apply. RFC 7671 section 5.2 should be read before deciding whether DANE-TA relaxes anything; it was not read during PKIX-rgc6.
- Key sizes and signature algorithms: no reason to differ from the TLS profile.

## Acceptance

[ ] RFC 7671 section 5.2 read and its bearing on DANE-TA date and name checks recorded
[ ] A profile added to pkix-profiles with require_subject_alt_name false, and the EKU question decided with a reason
[ ] verify_smtp_server_dane rustdoc points at it instead of warning about BasicTlsProfile
[ ] pkix-chain/tests/smtp_dane_e2e.rs uses it instead of its locally-defined MtaProfile
